svg.title: RMR control panel mains compartment wall
svg.text: RMR control panel: mains compartment wall

Two pieces of 1/16 in 5052 that close the 110 VAC compartment on the lower deck (sheet 3, view B), cut from the offcut of the upper plate's sheet. Flat patterns and section 1:2, plan 1:5, printed at 100 %. Millimetres.
A Wall A, flat, seen from the mains side
420.1 x 114.2; along x, mains face at y 182
bend line: flange: 90 deg away from the mains side
DC pass-through,
edge trim
tab to the
back panel
front end: B's corner tab screws on here
B Wall B, flat, mains side
bend line: corner tab: 90 deg toward the mains side
bend line: flange: 90 deg away from the mains side
tab to the right panel
C On the base plate, from above
1:5; mains parts dashed
PE
wall A, flange under it
wall B
PSU
110 V rail
door gland
D Section at a screw
103 wall
upper plate, 3 over the wall
base plate
K2
PSU
M4 x 12, nyloc below
low-voltage side
mains side
seen from the front: wall A and its flange
Material and cut
1/16 in 5052-H32 from the offcut of aluminum 2,
beside the upper plate (sheet 4): flat A 420.1 x 114.2,
B 163.2 x 114.2. Shear the blanks, nibble the end
tabs and B's corner relief, drill the Ø4.5
holes, cut the pass-through, deburr; DXF:
wall_mains_flat.dxf (layers CUT and BEND).
Bends
90 deg on a brake, inside radius one thickness.
K 0.42 is assumed: bend deduction 2.8 per bend.
Bend a test strip first and correct WallK if
its legs come out long or short. Flanges fold
away from the mains side; B's corner tab folds
toward it and lies on A's mains face.
Fastening and PE
Flanges: 6 M4 x 12 into the base plate, nyloc
below, 3.8 mm past the nut (NutFits). Corner:
2 M4 x 12 through B's tab and A, heads on the
mains side. Drill the base plate through the
flange holes in place. Each piece is its own
PE part: a ring lug under a flange screw.
Openings
End tabs reach between the rings to 2 mm from
the back and right panels; A and B stop 1 mm
short of the rings. B's tab, and a notch in the
top of B's right end, keep 1 mm from the front
right corner brackets and their screw heads,
taken as 20 mm legs (BracketChecks). Measure
a bracket before cutting B: a 4 mm key must
reach both screws of the front right post to
mid ring bracket past B's tab, its post screw
along x and its rail screw from below; if not,
lower the tab's top (TabHB) until it does.
The top stops 3 mm under the upper plate.
DC pass-through 40 x 13, 20 over the deck,
centred on the mains duct: PSU V+ and V- out.
Move it to the PSU's terminal end once that
face is known. The 110 V door cable leaves by
an M20 gland in the back panel (u 205), not
through the wall.
Upper plate
Drill no DIN rail or duct screw in these bands:
its nyloc and tail hang 9.4 mm under the plate,
and the wall stops 3 mm under it.
B corner tab: x 31.5 to 60, y 177 to 188.6
Fit
Before the lower deck's parts: flange screws,
then B's corner tab to A, then the PE jumpers.
Check that the upper module drops on clear.
Mains compartment wall
Sheet 5. Legal, landscape, 100 %.
Flat patterns and section 1:2, plan 1:5.
Designed 2026-10-18 (issue #146).
DXF: wall_mains_flat.dxf.
